article.title: -(으)ㄹ 수 없어요
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
article.chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력

claims.summary: The Korean Basic Dictionary defines **-(으)ㄹ 수 없다** (usually written **-ㄹ(을) 수 없다**) as indicating that something is not possible and gives examples such as **들을 수 없다**, **말할 수 없다**, and **물건을 들 수 없었다**. An NIKL report classifies **-(으)ㄹ 수 없다** as impossibility/capacity modality, separately from prohibition markers such as **-면 안 되다**. Thus “no se puede” can express inability or impossibility in context; the construction alone does not establish a rule-based prohibition.
